description: Native Perplexity (Sonar) web-grounded LLM inference via Perplexity's OpenAI-compatible API. Drop-in peer of openai_llm / anthropic_llm / gemini_llm / groq_llm / mistral_llm, but unlike those, Perplexity's responses are grounded with real-time web citations, which this component surfaces as its own output column and in materialization metadata. For multi-vendor routing use litellm_inference_asset.

outputs.description: Upstream DataFrame with the LLM response column, a web-citations column, and optional _error / search-result-detail columns added.

api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Perplexity API key.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

base_url.description: Perplexity OpenAI-compatible base URL. Override only for proxies.
base_url.label: Base URL

text_model.label: Text Model
text_model.description: Common: sonar, sonar-pro, sonar-reasoning, sonar-reasoning-pro, sonar-deep-research

user_prompt_template.description: Template with {column} placeholders. Mutually exclusive with input_column.
user_prompt_template.label: User Prompt Template

input_column.description: Column whose value becomes the per-row prompt. Mutually exclusive with user_prompt_template.
input_column.label: Input Column

citations_column.label: Citations Column
citations_column.description: Column holding the list of web source URLs cited for that row's answer.

include_search_results.label: Include Search Result Detail
include_search_results.description: Also add a '<citations_column>_detail' column with title/url/date/snippet per source.

search_domain_filter.label: Search Domain Filter
search_domain_filter.description: Allowlist domains, or denylist with a '-' prefix, e.g. ['-reddit.com']. Max 20.

search_recency_filter.description: Restrict search results to a recency window: 'day', 'week', 'month', or 'year'.
search_recency_filter.label: Search Recency Filter

return_related_questions.description: Ask Perplexity to also return suggested follow-up questions (surfaced in metadata, not per row).
return_related_questions.label: Return Related Questions

rate_limit_delay.description: Seconds to sleep between rows. Raise this if you hit Perplexity's rate limits.
rate_limit_delay.label: Rate Limit Delay

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

name: Perplexity LLM
